ablations.name: baseline_prod
ablations.description: Current production stack — all per-cell gates enabled.

ablations.name: no_kin_ood
ablations.description: Disable kin_ood demotion of aux-assisted elements.

ablations.name: sigma_global_0p5x
ablations.description: Replace per-element σ thresholds with 0.5× σ_train.

ablations.name: sigma_global_1x
ablations.description: Replace per-element σ thresholds with 1.0× σ_train.

ablations.name: sigma_global_2x
ablations.description: Replace per-element σ thresholds with 2.0× σ_train.

ablations.name: all_caveats_off
ablations.description: Drop ALL caveat flags (only OOD demotes).

ablations.name: all_ood_off
ablations.description: Drop ALL OOD flags (no Tier-3 demotions from OOD; only NaN predictions go to Tier 3).

ablations.name: minimal_gates
ablations.description: Drop ALL caveats AND OOD flags. Only NaN → Tier 3, σ-inflation → Tier 2.

ablations.name: prod_alpha_tightened
ablations.description: Production stack with α/M σ-threshold tightened from 0.10 → 0.05 dex (≈0.5×σ_train). Isolates the σ-tighten effect from the gate-set simplification.

ablations.name: recommended_no_alpha_tighten
ablations.description: Recommended gate-set simplification but with α/M σ-threshold left at 0.10. Isolates the gate-set effect from the σ-tighten.

ablations.name: recommended
ablations.description: Final 2026-04-26 recommendation. Mahalanobis OOD only; mode-ambiguous demotion on α/M only; kin_ood disabled (Stream-3 layer concern); all other gates dropped; α/M σ-threshold tightened to 0.05.
